thread:
mira: noticing a weird client behavior in prod-us-east around 11:45 — clients keep reconnecting immediately after a 204 from the edge, causing an increased billing_count but no active sessions. console shows "stuck_resume" traces piling up.

dan: raw log excerpt?

mira: sure:
```
2026-02-10T11:45:12Z edge-07 tenant=partnerX client=conn-9 response=204 resume_id=abc123
2026-02-10T11:45:12Z clientlib-1 tenant=partnerX client=conn-9 reconnect=attempt0 backoff=0s
2026-02-10T11:45:12Z edge-07 tenant=partnerX client=conn-9 response=204 resume_id=abc123
2026-02-10T11:45:13Z clientlib-1 tenant=partnerX client=conn-9 reconnect=attempt1 backoff=0s
2026-02-10T11:45:14Z router-03 tenant=partnerX tombstone=unset
```

lee: 204 path was added to handle opaque proxy revalidation during sticky routing rollout. We didn't intend for clientlib to treat 204 as terminal.

anya: clientlib: if response not in (200, 201, 206) we call reconnect() path that uses base_delay=0 unless Retry-After present. So 204 treated like soft-failure.

mira: ops-bot pulled recent deploy: sticky-routing v2 rolled at 11:30 by jenkins-canary

ops-bot: deploy eng-platform/sticky-routing v2 (build 20260210.8) rolled to prod at 11:30 UTC

dan: two-pronged fix: (1) clientlib should interpret 204 as non-retry (treat like 410-style tombstone) when resume_id present, or (2) server should return Retry-After for soft failures. Prefer server-side header because older clients may not understand 204 semantics.

lee: agree with server header for hotfix. We can also add an API change note for clientlib to treat 204-with-resume as tombstone in next release.

anya: telemetry request: add counter sse.resume.ignored204 and a sampling trace when a resume_id is used with 204 responses. console needs to show per-tenant recent-reconnects and resume_id churn.

mira: quick mitigation: router will detect 204 + resume_id -> set tombstone for tenant-route (ttl 45s) and emit Retry-After: 45. Also emit sse.tombstone.set metric. Is that safe?

dan: safe enough for canary. Add strict unit test for tombstone set on 204+resume_id and ensure existing 204 used by other flows (non-resume) are unaffected.

lee: I'll push patch to router + metrics. @anya please draft dashboard tiles.

anya: will do. Also logging: include resume_id in console alert link so we can jump to sampled traces.

mira: plan: canary 5% first, monitor billing_count vs active_sessions delta, then widen. If backfill of billing spikes occurs we rollback.

ops-bot: canary started for pr/589 to 5% at 11:58 UTC

dan: PR link pr/589 (WIP) — tombstone on 204+resume_id, Retry-After header, metric hooks.

mira: thanks. Once canary stable we'll schedule a clientlib patch to treat 204+resume as tombstone at next minor release.
